outlinedDefects: Folder contour is discontinuous: right/top and bottom strokes end with blunt caps and never join the lock (refs integrate badges into one continuous outline)
Uneven gaps between folder strokes and badge (bottom gap wider than upper-right)
Badge reads large vs ref badge scale; right side of folder feels open/unfinished
Shackle interior white space: yes (open loop)
filledDefects: Knockout halo is thick and eats the folder’s bottom-right corner/right edge more than ref badged fills
At 24px/16px the badge separation and shackle hole tighten; preview-16 shackle nearly clogs to a dark blob
Shackle interior white space: yes at master size; marginal/near-lost when downsampled
verdict.reason: Outlined fails reference contour continuity (floating badge vs merged stroke). Filled keeps a readable lock at large size but over-knocks the corner and loses shackle clarity at native/16. Neither paint matches reference badge integration or small-size legibility.

review.invalidRule: Reference family does not require continuous outlines around badges
